title: Chapter 165 I Know Your Majesty
content:
Chapter 165 I Know Your Majesty

The war was about to start.

Facing the countless Soul Devouring Clan troops and three peak Mortal Realm warriors.

The armored man had no fear in his eyes and rushed forward with his gun.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng was a little excited.

It can be said that he was a man standing alone!

After an unknown amount of time, the noise finally slowly dissipated.

And the armored man also achieved his goal.

With his own strength, he held back the entire Soul Devouring Clan army, and the armored man's strength was also very terrifying, one against three, and he was facing three peak Mortal Realm warriors.

Although he couldn't be as powerful as Yan Lingyun, he was not weak against three, and he could even gain an advantage.

But the armored man also used his strength to hold back the opponent for a long time.

"Damn, it's so hard to kill!"

Shi Jin's face was a little ugly, he spit, and then he quickly led the entire Soul Devouring Clan army to rush towards the direction of the Divine Dynasty's imperial capital.

At this point, the scene ends.

At this time, in front of Lu Daosheng, an armless man was lying alone in the void. Even though there was no life, his body still exuded the powerful aura of his life.

This is the first general of the Divine Dynasty.

God One!

"As expected of my wife, she still has such a good vision."

Lu Daosheng couldn't help but praise her, and then he slowly stretched out his right hand and spread his palm.

Buzz——

Suddenly, countless ethereal auras continued to gather here from the void.

At the same time, a faint vitality suddenly emerged out of thin air.

[Host, do you need the system to help you?]

The voice of the system suddenly sounded in Lu Daosheng's mind.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled lightly and said, "No, I can do this kind of thing myself."

Then, the system stopped making any sound.

After a moment.

There was a click.

That was the sound of the rules being broken.

The next moment, a murmur sounded.

"Where am I?"

Shen Yi slowly opened his eyes, and his eyes looked around lifelessly.

At this moment, his broken arms were miraculously restored.

But compared to resurrection from the dead, it was nothing.

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Shen Yi was slightly stunned.

"Who are you?"

Lu Daosheng smiled and was about to speak.

Boom!

A roar sounded.

The next moment, the sky suddenly cracked a hideous crack.

Then, a destructive breath suddenly descended.

"Who are you, ants, dare to ignore the rules, don't you want to live?!"

A voice like a god exploded from the void.

Instantly, the whole world began to tremble wildly.

Feeling this breath, Shen Yi looked horrified.

What kind of terrifying existence is this? !

However, he didn't know at this moment that the truly terrifying existence was right next to him.

On the other side

At the unknown border, Yan Lingyun and Shi Ling also stopped suddenly.

At this moment, Shi Ling's eyes showed a look of horror.

There is such a thing in this world.

He couldn't believe it.

A sense of frustration slowly rose from his heart.

On the other hand, Yan Lingyun seemed to be calmer.

But he still frowned and looked in that direction.

"Samsara Hall? Someone is breaking the reincarnation?"

She could have done this kind of method when she was at her peak, but she would suffer huge consequences.

If you are not careful, you may even die.

And now, in this world, someone actually used this method.

Could it be?

As if thinking of something, Yan Lingyun's heart trembled suddenly.

Then, Yan Lingyun looked at Jian Xinhuangshou and others who had not left in the distance.

"You go back first."

Hearing this, everyone was slightly stunned.

But he still nodded and said, "Yes, Your Majesty (Madam)."

Watching everyone leave, Yan Lingyun slowly turned around and looked at Shi Ling.

"Cherish your few moments."

Hearing this, Shi Ling was a little puzzled.

But at this time, Yan Lingyun had already rushed towards her again.

Seeing this, Shi Ling hurriedly took action.

For some reason, no matter how his strength improved, Yan Lingyun could always suppress him.

This made him have to doubt his life.

Is this still a human?

.........

Above the sky.

A majestic shadow slowly emerged, and the pair of eyes like endless stars looked at Lu Daosheng and the others.

Instantly, Shen Yi was like facing a great enemy.

"Who gave you the courage to go against reincarnation!"

The shadow slowly spoke.

The voice fell, and the void exploded directly.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng had no expression on his face, but slowly stretched out his hands.

Buzz——

I saw a hazy ball of light slowly condensing from the palm of his hand.

"The origin of reincarnation!"

"You, who are you?!"

Seeing the ball of light, the shadow instantly became uneasy, staring at the palm of Lu Daosheng's hand with disbelief in his eyes.

In his cognition, such a thing could not appear in this world.

"Do you think it's important who I am?"

Lu Daosheng said lightly.

Hearing this, the shadow suddenly reacted.

Yes, is it still important?

The existence of such a thing is not something I can provoke at all.

Suddenly, the shadow began to tremble.

"My lord, excuse me."

After the voice fell, the shadow disappeared directly on the spot.

On the side, Shen Yi was a little confused.

What happened.

"This, this senior, you?"

Lu Daosheng turned to look at Shen Yi, and Shen Yi's body tensed up.

"Don't be nervous, you should know that you have died once."

Hearing this, Shen Yi nodded slightly.

It was because he died once that he was a little confused.

Didn't he die? Why did he feel safe now?

If it weren't for the familiar environment around him, he even thought he had arrived at the legendary underworld.

"I saved you."

Shen Yi was shocked, but he had actually guessed it a long time ago.

It was still a little unbelievable to hear it with his own ears.

Resurrection from the dead, this method is really unheard of.

"Senior, how can I repay you?"

Shen Yi looked solemn.

He knew that the other party would never save him for no reason.

Moreover, the scene just now was even more vivid. The other party had paid a price to save him.

The other party was extremely extraordinary and had exceeded his cognition.

This favor was really too great.

Hearing Shen Yi's words, Lu Daosheng smiled.

"If I tell you to follow me, what will you do?"

As soon as these words came out, Shen Yi's expression was a little gloomy.

"Senior, I already have someone I want to follow for my whole life. Sorry, I can't meet this request."

Then, Shen Yi actually knelt down directly in front of Lu Daosheng.

"Senior, I, Shen Yi, have only knelt down to one person in my life except my parents."

"And now, I, Shen Yi, kneel down to you."

"Senior's great kindness, I will never forget it!"

Looking at Shen Yi kneeling in front of him, a gleam of light flashed in Lu Daosheng's eyes.

"Get up."

Shen Yi was indifferent.

Lu Daosheng smiled bitterly, "Actually, I saved you because I know your Majesty."

Hearing this, Shen Yi was stunned for a moment.

And Lu Daosheng was also somewhat helpless.

I wanted to say that I was your Majesty's man, but after thinking about it, I decided not to say so.

This kind of thing, it doesn't matter whether you say it or not.

"Senior, how is the imperial capital?"

Shen Yi asked first after he stood up.
